newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Q1 GDP growth 4.21 pct -- IBGE.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Q1 GDP growth 4.21 pct -- IBGE.

text.p: Brazilian gross domestic product in the first quarter of 1997 grew 4.21 percent compared with the same period last year, and decreased 0.56 percent on the fourth quarter of 1996, said the National Statistics Institute (IBGE).
The IBGE said the figures reflected growth rates of 6.08 percent in agriculture and 5.27 percent in industry in comparison with the same period last year.
((--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro Newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
